title: Choose the visual world for The Tooth Care, premium and bold
question: Premium and modern, pushed further. Three committed worlds at full nerve, plus the premium standard. You pick.

options.label: Signature Blue
options.lineage: Monochrome brand worlds: one colour owning everything, the way a luxury house owns its colour
options.thesis: The page is the logo blue. Every surface, every panel, every photo tint is navy or ice-white; the practice becomes unmistakable by colour alone.
materials: navy drenching 70 percent of the surface
options.viewport: Full navy. The logo large and white, top-left. A giant white headline across the whole width, 'We talk first. Then we treat.', a duotone photo of a dentist and patient set into the lower right, and a single white pill: Message us on WhatsApp. Facts run as a white strip: 4.8 on Google, Bashundhara and Nadda, open till 11 PM.
options.risk: Monochrome can flatten warmth; the duotone photography must show faces clearly. Bold and instantly memorable, but it demands discipline on every later page.

options.label: The Monograph
options.lineage: Large-format design monographs and fashion-house editorial: enormous type, asymmetric white space, one image per spread
options.thesis: Typography at the scale of a poster, space at the scale of a gallery. The words we choose are the design.
materials: a display serif at 8 to 12 vw
options.viewport: Almost nothing but type. The word 'Painless.' at poster scale, a short line under it: 'Because we explain everything before we touch anything.' Small logo and phones in the corners. One navy action, Message us on WhatsApp, and below the fold a full-width photograph.
options.risk: A single word carries the whole first impression; if it reads as a claim rather than a promise the page feels arrogant. The most distinctive of the three and the least like a clinic at first glance.

options.label: The Cinematic Practice
options.lineage: Film-title sequences and flagship product launches: full-bleed motion, slow reveals, type entering over footage
options.thesis: The clinic seen as a film: full-screen footage of the rooms and the team, headlines arriving over it, the scroll paced like a title sequence.
materials: navy for the action and the logo panel
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge footage (a still until video exists) of the dentist greeting a patient at the door, dimmed at the base; the logo top-left in a small navy panel; a white headline rising over the image, 'Unhurried dentistry, open till 11 PM.'; the navy Message us on WhatsApp button; a thin scroll cue.
options.risk: Needs real footage; stand-ins cannot carry it. Heavy assets fight the 300 KB budget unless the video is deferred and the poster frame is optimised. The most impressive, and the most dependent on production.

canonCard.label: The premium category standard
canonCard.thesis: The modern clinic site the best competitors ship, executed at full craft with the 'we' voice and real facts.
canonCard.viewport: Header with logo and phone, hero with a large photo, a warm headline, trust line, and a blue Message us on WhatsApp button; then services grid, reviews, team, locations with maps, footer.
